task_description: Build a fully functional copy trading dashboard for managing funding company accounts, creating copy groups with configurable risk, viewing metrics, and connecting with Tradovate and other platforms. Full-stack Next.js 14 app with serverless backend, Google auth, and modern responsive UI.

verification.summary: Build succeeds cleanly. All 146 tests pass across 8 test files. Two review passes conducted (v1 and v2) with all identified issues resolved: credential security, copy engine runtime integration, field name bugs, settings persistence, platform gating, daily-loss calculation, adapter lifecycle, encryption at rest, and webhook external auth.
